versions.content: Common action for all inputOutputControlParameter op- erations with atomic S/R If the Dcm is processing an InputOutputControlByIdentifier request for a DID configured atomic S/R interface, the Dcm module shall update in the IOControlRequest_DID the data element IOOperationRequest with 1. controlEnableMask = controlEnableMaskRecord of the request message 2. inputOutputControlParameter = inputOutputControlParameter from the re- quest message
